Capabilities

Intelligent Lab Management

Our real-time monitoring platform delivers comprehensive oversight of your IVF laboratory operations, from equipment status to patient cycle tracking.

Equipment Monitoring

Track incubator temperatures, CO2 levels, humidity, and critical equipment parameters around the clock with instant alerts for any deviations.

Patient Cycle Tracking

Automated monitoring of every patient cycle from retrieval through transfer, with comprehensive documentation for compliance and quality assurance.

Intelligent Alerts

Configurable alert thresholds with multi-channel notifications — SMS, email, and in-app — ensuring your team can respond immediately to any issue.

Quality Control Dashboards

Comprehensive visual dashboards displaying KPIs, trend analysis, and quality metrics — giving laboratory directors the insights to make data-driven decisions.

Compliance Documentation

Automatic generation of regulatory-ready documentation, audit trails, and compliance reports to support your inspection and accreditation readiness.
